headings: Our Industry Cloud Solutions for Life Sciences
paragraphs: Veeva is the leading provider of industry cloud solutions for the global life sciences industry. Our offerings span cloud software, data, and business consulting and are designed to meet the unique needs of our customers and their most strategic business functions—from research and development ("R&D") through commercialization. Our solutions help life sciences companies develop and bring products to market faster and more efficiently, market and sell more effectively, and maintain compliance with government regulations. Our goal is to become the most strategic software, data, and business consulting partner to the life sciences industry, supporting the industry's most critical drug development, quality and manufacturing, and commercialization functions.

Customer success is one of our core values, and our focus on it has allowed us to deepen and expand our strategic relationships with customers over time. Because of our industry focus, we have a unique, in-depth perspective into the needs and best practices of life sciences companies and clinical research sites. This allows us to develop targeted solutions, quickly adapt to regulatory changes, and incorporate highly relevant enhancements into our existing solutions at a rapid pace.

We are a Delaware public benefit corporation ("PBC"). A PBC is a for-profit company operating under subchapter XV of the General Corporation Law of the State of Delaware (i) that has adopted a public benefit purpose intended to provide benefits beyond just stockholder financial returns, and (ii) whose directors have a fiduciary duty to balance the financial interests of stockholders, the best interests of other stakeholders materially affected by the company's conduct (which we believe includes customers, employees, partners, and the communities in which we operate), and the pursuit of the company's public benefit purpose. Our public benefit purpose, as reflected in our certificate of incorporation, is "to provide products and services that are intended to help make the industries we serve more productive, and to create high-quality employment opportunities in the communities in which we operate." We believe that operating as a PBC reflects our core values—do the right thing, customer success, employee success, and speed—and helps us maintain alignment with the principal industry we serve, life sciences, and its broad goal to improve health and extend lives.

Our industry cloud solutions for the life sciences industry are grouped into four major product categories—Veeva Development Cloud, Veeva Quality Cloud, Veeva Commercial Cloud, and Veeva Data Cloud—and are designed to address pharmaceutical, biotechnology, and medical devices and diagnostics (MedTech) companies' most pressing strategic needs in their commercial, R&D, and quality operations.

For financial reporting purposes, "Commercial Solutions" revenues refer to revenues associated with our Veeva Commercial Cloud and Veeva Data Cloud solutions, and "R&D and Quality Solutions" revenues refer to revenues associated with our Veeva Development Cloud and Veeva Quality Cloud solutions.

Veeva AI adds agentic artificial intelligence ("AI") to our proprietary Veeva Vault platform and deep, industry-specific agents for Veeva applications. Veeva AI Agents work seamlessly within Veeva applications and have direct, secure access to data, documents, and workflows.

Veeva Development Cloud includes application suites for the clinical, regulatory, and safety functions of life sciences companies, all built on our Veeva Vault platform. Veeva Vault's unique ability to handle content and data allows us to build content and data-centric applications to help customers streamline end-to-end business processes and eliminate manual processes and siloed systems. Veeva Vault can be deployed one application at a time or as an integrated solution with multiple applications that enable customers to unify and manage important documents and related data in a single global system:

•Veeva Clinical Platform advances clinical trial execution by providing a complete and connected technology ecosystem. Our clinical platform is designed to enable seamless execution and flow of data between clinical trial stakeholders—including patients, research sites, contract research organizations ("CROs"), and trial sponsors—for faster, more efficient trials that achieve higher data accuracy and increased patient diversity. Our suite of applications for clinical research sites and patient engagement facilitates clinical trial participation for patients and streamlines study execution for research sites and trial sponsors. These offerings include applications that enable sites to manage study documents electronically and securely capture and exchange information with sponsors and CROs.

•Veeva Clinical Data Management helps sponsors and CROs design and run trials with tools to speed the build process and eliminate manual steps. This includes Veeva EDC for electronic data capture; Veeva CDB for aggregating, cleaning, and transforming clinical data; and solutions for electronic processing of consents and assessments of clinical trial participants. Veeva Clinical Operations Suite offers applications such as Veeva eTMF, an electronic trial master file application, Veeva CTMS for clinical trial management, solutions for randomization and trial supply management (RTSM), and solutions for automating the flow of clinical trial information between sponsors, CROs, and clinical research sites for better collaboration and faster clinical trials.

•Veeva Safety is a suite of applications that unifies systems and processes to enable proactive patient safety. These offerings include applications that manage drug safety content, reporting and analytics, signal detection, as well as the intake, processing, and submission of adverse event data.

•Veeva RIM is a suite of applications that provides fully integrated regulatory information management capabilities on a single cloud platform. These offerings include applications that enable life sciences companies to manage, track, and report product and registration information and to facilitate content planning, authoring, publishing, and archiving of regulatory submissions to healthcare authorities.

Veeva Quality Cloud unifies quality applications, processes, and partners across content management, training, quality assurance, and quality control lab solutions on the Veeva Vault platform. These applications help our customers in the life sciences and consumer products industries to develop and manufacture products more efficiently. Veeva Quality Cloud includes Veeva QMS to manage integrated quality processes and Veeva Quality Docs to manage regulated quality content throughout its lifecycle, as well as lab solutions, which enable quality control to optimize batch release testing, stability study management, and environmental monitoring, and training solutions, which increase quality training efficiency and compliance.

Veeva Commercial Cloud is a product category comprised of software and analytics solutions built specifically for life sciences companies to more efficiently and effectively commercialize their products. Veeva Commercial Cloud includes solutions for the sales, marketing, and medical affairs functions of a life sciences company:

•Veeva Vault CRM Suite is our next generation CRM solution built on our proprietary Veeva Vault platform. Vault CRM brings together sales, marketing, medical, and service teams at pharmaceutical and biotechnology companies in a single Vault database, with shared data and content, to manage, track, and optimize engagement with healthcare professionals. Vault CRM includes the full functionality of our legacy product, Veeva CRM, with additional applications such as Campaign Manager for coordination across engagement channels, Patient CRM for patient services, and integrated AI Agents that enhance field productivity and data quality by providing data-driven pre-call insights, enabling voice-activated data entry and follow-up actions, and identifying potential issues in call notes to ensure accuracy and compliance. Veeva CRM and some of its related applications are built on a platform provided by Salesforce, Inc. and will be supported until December 31, 2029. Both Vault CRM and Veeva CRM include multichannel CRM applications that can enhance and extend our core CRM and Medical CRM products, providing customers with an end-to-end solution across all key channels, including face-to-face, email, and virtual engagement, live and virtual enterprise events, and field collaboration.

headings: We face intense competition in markets in which we operate and if we do not compete effectively, we may lose customers and our business and operating results could be adversely affected.
Defects or disruptions in our solutions could result in diminished demand for our solutions, a reduction in our revenues, and subject us to substantial liability.
If our newer solutions are not successfully adopted by new and existing customers, the growth rate of our revenues and operating results will be adversely affected.
Sales to customers outside the United States or with international operations expose us to risks inherent in international sales.
The migration of our CRM customers to our Vault CRM applications built on our own Veeva Vault platform could cause business disruptions for customers and adversely affect our operating results.
Difficulty attracting and retaining highly skilled employees could adversely affect our business and efforts to attract and retain such employees may increase our expenses.
Catastrophic events could disrupt our business and adversely affect our operating results.
Acquisitions could divert our management's attention, result in additional dilution to our stockholders, and otherwise disrupt our operations.
Changes in our senior management team or other key personnel could have a negative effect on our ability to execute our business strategy.
Our business could be adversely affected if our customers are not satisfied with the professional or technical support services provided by us or our partners.
Risks Related to the Principal Industry We Serve
Increasingly complex regulations relating to privacy, data protection, and cybersecurity are burdensome, may reduce demand for our solutions, and non-compliance may impose significant liabilities.
paragraphs: Investing in our common stock involves a high degree of risk. You should consider carefully the risks and uncertainties described below and in "Management's Discussion and Analysis of Financial Condition and Results of Operations," together with all of the other information in this report, including our consolidated financial statements and related notes, before investing in our common stock. The risks and uncertainties described below are not the only ones we face. If any of the following risks actually occurs, our business, financial condition, results of operations, and prospects could be materially and adversely affected. In that event, the price of our common stock could decline and you could lose part or all of your investment.

The below is a summary of principal risks to our business and risks associated with ownership of our stock. It is only a summary. You should read the more detailed discussion of risks set forth below and elsewhere in this report for a more complete discussion of the risks listed below and other risks.

•If our security measures are breached or unauthorized access to customer data is otherwise obtained, our solutions may be perceived as not being secure, customers may reduce or stop the use of our solutions, and we may incur significant liabilities.

•We face intense competition in markets in which we operate—particularly in the CRM market as we transition customers from our legacy CRM application to our Vault CRM application—and if we do not compete effectively, we may lose customers and our business and operating results could be adversely affected.
•Defects or disruptions in our solutions could result in diminished demand for our solutions and a reduction in our revenues, and subject us to substantial liability.
•If our newer solutions are not successfully adopted by new and existing customers, the growth rate of our revenues and operating results will be adversely affected.

paragraphs: You should read the following discussion and analysis of our financial condition and results of operations in conjunction with our consolidated financial statements and notes thereto appearing elsewhere in this report. In addition to historical consolidated financial information, the following discussion and analysis contains forward-looking statements that involve risks, uncertainties, and assumptions. Our actual results could differ materially from those anticipated by these forward-looking statements as a result of many factors. We discuss factors that we believe could cause or contribute to these differences below and elsewhere in this report, including those set forth under "Risk Factors" and "Special Note Regarding Forward-Looking Statements."

Veeva is the leading provider of industry cloud solutions for the global life sciences industry. Our offerings span cloud software, data, and business consulting and are designed to meet the unique needs of our customers and their most strategic business functions—from research and development ("R&D") through commercialization. Our solutions help life sciences companies develop and bring products to market faster and more efficiently, market and sell more effectively, and maintain compliance with government regulations.

Our industry cloud solutions are grouped into four major product categories—Veeva Development Cloud, Veeva Quality Cloud, Veeva Commercial Cloud, and Veeva Data Cloud. For financial reporting purposes, "Commercial Solutions" revenues refer to revenues associated with our Veeva Commercial Cloud and Veeva Data Cloud solutions, and "R&D and Quality Solutions" revenues refer to revenues associated with our Veeva Development Cloud and Veeva Quality Cloud solutions.

In our fiscal year ended January 31, 2026, we derived approximately 47% and 53% of our subscription revenues and 45% and 55% of our total revenues from our Commercial Solutions and R&D and Quality Solutions, respectively. For the fiscal year ended January 31, 2025, we derived approximately 48% and 52% of our subscription revenues and 47% and 53% of our total revenues from our Commercial Solutions and R&D and Quality Solutions, respectively. Revenues associated with our R&D and Quality Solutions are expected to increase as a percentage of both subscription revenues and total revenues in the future. We also offer certain of our R&D and Quality Solutions to industries outside the life sciences industry primarily in North America and Europe.

For our fiscal years ended January 31, 2026, 2025, and 2024, our total revenues were $3,195 million, $2,747 million, and $2,364 million, respectively, representing year-over-year growth in total revenues of 16% in our fiscal year ended January 31, 2026, and 16% in our fiscal year ended January 31, 2025. For our fiscal years ended January 31, 2026, 2025, and 2024, our subscription revenues were $2,684 million, $2,285 million, and $1,902 million, respectively, representing year-over-year growth in subscription revenues of 17% in our fiscal year ended January 31, 2026, and 20% in our fiscal year ended January 31, 2025. We generated net income of $909 million, $714 million, and $526 million for our fiscal years ended January 31, 2026, 2025, and 2024, respectively.

As of January 31, 2026, 2025, and 2024, we served 1,552, 1,477, and 1,432 customers, respectively. As of January 31, 2026, 2025, and 2024, we had 767, 730, and 693 Commercial Solutions customers, respectively, and 1,196, 1,125, and 1,078 R&D and Quality Solutions customers, respectively. These customer count totals are net of customer attrition during each period. The combined customer counts for Commercial Solutions and R&D and Quality Solutions exceed the total customer count in each year because some customers subscribe to products in both areas. Many of our applications for R&D are used by smaller, earlier-stage, pre-commercial companies, some of which may not reach the commercialization stage.

We derive our revenues primarily from subscription fees and professional services fees. Subscription revenues consist of fees from customers accessing our software and data solutions. Professional services and other revenues consist primarily of fees from implementation services, configuration, and managed services in connection with our solutions, as well as services related to our speakers bureau logistics and Veeva Business Consulting
offering. For the fiscal year ended January 31, 2026, subscription revenues constituted 84% of total revenues and professional services and other revenues constituted 16% of total revenues.

We generally enter into master subscription agreements with our customers and count each distinct master subscription agreement that has not been terminated or expired and that has orders for which we have recognized revenue in the quarter as a distinct customer for purposes of determining our total number of current customers as of the end of that quarter. We generally enter into a single master subscription agreement with each customer, although in some instances, affiliated legal entities within the same corporate family may enter into separate master subscription agreements. Conversely, affiliated legal entities that maintain distinct master subscription agreements may choose to consolidate their orders under a single master subscription agreement, and, in that circumstance, our customer count would decrease. Divisions, subsidiaries, and operating units of our customers often place distinct orders for our subscription services under the same master subscription agreement, and we do not count such distinct orders as new customers for purposes of determining our total customer count. For Veeva Crossix, we do not count as distinct customers agencies contracting with us on behalf of brands within life sciences companies.

New subscription orders for our CRM applications generally have a one-year term. If a customer adds end users or additional Commercial Solutions to an existing order for a CRM application, such additional orders will generally be coterminous with the anniversary date of the CRM order, and as a result, orders for additional end users or additional Commercial Solutions will commonly have an initial term of less than one year.

Subscription revenues are generally recognized ratably over the respective noncancellable subscription term because of the continuous transfer of control to the customer. Our master subscription agreements governing multi-year orders generally include a termination for convenience right for our customers. The amount of revenue recognized from such orders will generally be consistent with the amount invoiced for the relevant term of the order.

Our subscription orders are generally billed at the beginning of the subscription period in annual or quarterly increments, which means the annualized value of such orders may not be completely reflected in deferred revenue at any single point in time. Also, particularly with respect to expansion orders for our Commercial Solutions, because the term of orders for additional end users or applications is commonly less than one year to align to the renewal date of existing Commercial Solutions orders, the annualized value of such orders may not be completely reflected in deferred revenue at any single point in time. We have also agreed from time to time, and may agree in the future, to allow customers to change the renewal dates of their orders to, for example, align more closely with a customer's annual budget process or to align with the renewal dates of other orders placed by other entities within the same corporate control group, or to change payment terms from annual to quarterly, or vice versa. Such changes may result in an order of less than one year as necessary to align all orders to the desired renewal date and, thus, may result in a lesser increase to deferred revenue compared to if the adjustment had not occurred. Additionally, changes in renewal dates may change the fiscal quarter in which deferred revenue associated with a particular order is booked. Accordingly, we do not believe that changes on a quarterly or annual basis in deferred revenue, calculated billings, or normalized billings are precise indicators of future revenues. We define the term calculated billings for any period to mean revenue for the period plus the change in deferred revenue from the immediately preceding period minus the change in unbilled accounts receivable from the immediately preceding period. We define the term normalized billings for any period to mean calculated billings adjusted for the impact of (i) term changes in our customer renewals, such as changes to renewal date (for example, changing the renewal date of multiple products to be coterminous) or changes to billing frequency (for example, changing from annual to quarterly billings), and (ii) delayed renewals that have closed and billed after the period end.

Our agreements typically provide that orders will automatically renew unless notice of non-renewal is provided in advance. Subscription revenues are affected primarily by the number of customers, the scope of the subscription purchased by each customer (for example, the number of end users or other subscription usage metric) and the number of solutions subscribed to by each customer.

We utilize our own personnel to perform our professional services and business consulting engagements with customers. In certain cases, we may utilize third-party subcontractors to perform professional services engagements. The majority of our professional services arrangements are billed on a time and materials basis and revenues are recognized over time based on time incurred and contractually agreed upon rates. Certain professional services and business consulting arrangements are billed on a fixed fee basis and revenues are typically recognized over time as the services are delivered based on time incurred. headings: 本公司生命科學產業雲端解決方案
規則 規則 說明
paragraphs: Veeva 是全球生命科學產業雲端解決方案的領導供應商。我們的產品涵蓋雲端軟體、資料與商業諮詢服務，並針對客戶及其最重要的戰略業務功能—從研究與開發（"R&D"）至商業化—設計以滿足其獨特需求。我們的解決方案協助生命科學公司更快速且更有效率地開發並將產品推向市場，更有效地行銷與銷售，並符合政府規範。我們的目標是成為生命科學產業最重要的軟體、資料與商業諮詢夥伴，支援產業最重要的藥物開發、品質與製造，以及商業化功能。
客戶成功是我們的核心價值之一，我們對此的著重使我們能隨著時間深化並擴展與客戶的戰略關係。由於我們專注於產業領域，我們對生命科學公司與臨牀研究場地的需求與最佳實務有獨特且深入的洞察。這使我們能發展針對性的解決方案，迅速適應規範變動，並以快速的節奏將高度相關的改進功能納入現有解決方案中。

我們是特拉華州的公共利益公司（"PBC"）。PBC 是一種營利性公司，根據特拉華州一般公司法第十五章（subchapter XV）運作，（i）已採納旨在提供超越股東財務回報的公共利益目的，且（ii）董事會有義務在股東的財務利益、受公司行為影響的其他利益相關者（我們認為包括客戶、員工、合作夥伴及我們運作的社區）的最佳利益，以及公司追求的公共利益目的之間取得平衡。我們的公共利益目的，如我們的章程所反映的，是 "提供產品與服務，以協助我們服務的產業變得更具生產力，並在我們運作的社區中創造高品質的就業機會。" 我們相信以 PBC 的形式運作反映了我們的核心價值觀—做正確的事、客戶成功、員工成功與速度—並幫助我們與我們服務的主要產業，生命科學產業，及其廣泛目標改善健康與延長生命保持一致。
我們為生命科學產業提供的雲端解決方案分為四大主要產品類別—Veeva Development Cloud、Veeva Quality Cloud、Veeva Commercial Cloud 和 Veeva Data Cloud—並設計用以解決製藥、生物技術與醫療器材與診斷（MedTech）公司在其商業、R&D 與品質運作中最重要的戰略需求。
就財務報導而言，"商業解決方案"收入指的是與我們 Veeva Commercial Cloud 和 Veeva Data Cloud 解決方案相關的收入，"R&D 與品質解決方案"收入指的是與我們 Veeva Development Cloud 和 Veeva Quality Cloud 解決方案相關的收入。
Veeva AI 將自主型人工智慧（"AI"）加入我們專有的 Veeva Vault 平台，並為 Veeva 應用程式提供深入的產業特定代理。Veeva AI 代理可在 Veeva 應用程式內順暢運作，並可直接且安全地存取資料、文件與工作流程。

Veeva Development Cloud 包含用於生命科學公司臨牀、法規與安全功能的應用程式組合，所有皆建於我們的 Veeva Vault 平台之上。Veeva Vault 獨特的處理內容與資料能力，使我們能建立以內容與資料為中心的應用程式，協助客戶簡化端到端業務流程，並消除手動流程與孤島式系統。Veeva Vault 可以一次部署一個應用程式，或作為整合解決方案與多個應用程式一起部署，使客戶能在單一全球系統中統一管理重要文件與相關資料：

•Veeva Clinical Platform 透過提供完整的連接科技生態系統，促進臨牀試驗的執行。我們的臨牀平台設計用以使臨牀試驗相關利害關係人—包括患者、研究場地、合同研究機構（"CROs"）及試驗贊助人—之間的資料執行與流動更加順暢，以實現更快、更有效率的試驗，並提高資料準確性與患者多樣性。我們為臨牀研究場地與患者參與所設計的應用程式組合，促進患者參與臨牀試驗，並為研究場地與試驗贊助人簡化試驗執行流程。這些產品包括讓場地能電子化且安全地管理試驗文件，並與贊助人及 CROs 進行資訊交換的應用程式。

•Veeva Clinical Data Management 幫助贊助者與 CROs 設計並執行試驗，提供工具以加速建置流程並消除手動步驟。這包括 Veeva EDC 用於電子資料收集；Veeva CDB 用於彙整、清理與轉換臨牀資料；以及用於電子處理同意書與臨牀試驗參與者評估的解決方案。Veeva Clinical Operations Suite 提供應用程式，例如 Veeva eTMF，為電子試驗主檔應用程式；Veeva CTMS 用於臨牀試驗管理；解決方案用於隨機化與試驗供應管理（RTSM）；以及解決方案用於自動化贊助者、CROs 與臨牀研究場地之間的臨牀試驗資訊流，以促進更好的合作與更快的臨牀試驗。
•Veeva Safety 是一套應用程式，用以統合系統與流程，以實現主動的患者安全。這些產品包括管理藥物安全內容、報告與分析、信號偵測的應用程式，以及處理、處理及提交不良事件資料的應用程式。
•Vee, RIM 是一套應用程式，提供完整的監管資訊管理能力於單一雲端平台。這些產品包括應用程式，使生命科學公司能管理、追蹤與報告產品與註冊資訊，並促進內容規劃、撰寫、發佈與歸檔監管提交至衛生當局。

Veeva Quality Cloud 統合品質應用程式、流程與合作夥伴於內容管理、培訓、品質保證與品質控制實驗室解決方案於 Veeva Vault 平台。這些應用程式協助我們在生命科學與消費品產業的客戶更有效率地開發與製造產品。Veeva Quality Cloud 包含 Veeva QMS 用於管理整合的品質流程，以及 Veeva Quality Docs 用於管理受管制的品質內容於其整個生命週期，以及實驗室解決方案，使品質控制能優化批次放行測試、穩定性研究管理與環境監測，以及培訓解決方案，提高品質培訓效率與合規性。
Veeva Commercial Cloud 是一個產品類別，包含專為生命科學公司設計的軟體與分析解決方案，以更有效率與效果地商業化其產品。Veeva Commercial Cloud 包含用於生命科學公司銷售、行銷與醫療事務功能的解決方案：

•Veeva Vault CRM Suite 是我們新一代的 CRM 解決方案，建於我們專有的 Veeva Vault 平台。Vault CRM 將藥物與生物科技公司的銷售、行銷、醫療與服務團隊於單一 Vault 數據庫中整合，共享資料與內容，以管理、追蹤與優化與醫療專業人員的互動。Vault CRM 包含我們舊有產品 Veeva CRM 的完整功能，並增加應用程式，例如 Campaign Manager 用於跨互動渠道的協調、Patient CRM 用於患者服務，以及整合的 AI Agents 用以提高現場作業效率與資料品質，透過提供資料驅動的預約前洞察，實現語音啟動的資料輸入與後續行動，並識別呼叫筆記中的潛在問題，以確保準確性與合規性。Veeva CRM 以及部分相關應用程式建於 Salesforce, Inc. 提供的平台，將支援至 2029 年 12 月 31 日。Vault CRM 與 Veeva CRM 都包含多渠道 CRM 應用程式，可增強與延伸我們的核心 CRM 與醫療 CRM 產品，為客戶提供跨所有關鍵渠道的端到端解決方案，包括面對面、電子郵件與虛擬互動，以及實體與虛擬企業活動，以及現場合作。

paragraphs: 您應配合本公司的合併財務報表及其附註，閱讀以下對我們財務狀況及營運成果的討論與分析。除了歷史合併財務資訊外，以下討論與分析包含涉及風險、不確定性與假設的向前看陳述。我們的實際結果可能與這些向前看陳述所預期的有重大差異，這是因為許多因素的影響。我們在以下及本報告其他部分討論我們認為可能導致或促成這些差異的因素，包括「風險因素」及「向前看陳述特別說明」中所列的內容。
Veeva 是全球生命科學產業雲端解決方案的領導供應商。我們的產品涵蓋雲端軟體、資料與商業諮詢服務，並針對客戶及其最重要的商業功能（從研究與開發（"R&D"）至商業化）設計，以滿足其獨特需求。我們的解決方案協助生命科學公司更快、更有效地開發產品並推向市場，更有效地行銷與銷售，並維持符合政府規範。

我們的產業雲端解決方案分為四大主要產品類別—Veeva Development Cloud、Veeva Quality Cloud、Veeva Commercial Cloud 以及 Veeva Data Cloud。就財務報導目的而言，"Commercial Solutions" 收入指的是與我們 Veeva Commercial Cloud 與 Veeva Data Cloud 解決方案相關的收入，"R&D and Quality Solutions" 收入指的是與我們 Veeva Development Cloud 與 Veeva Quality Cloud 解決方案相關的收入。

在我們財務年度截至 2026 年 1 月 31 日，我們約有 47% 與 53% 的訂閱收入以及 45% 與 55% 的總收入來自 Commercial Solutions 與 R&D and Quality Solutions。在財務年度截至 2025 年 1 月 31 日，我們約有 48% 與 52% 的訂閱收入以及 47% 與 53% 的總收入來自 Commercial Solutions 與 R&D and Quality Solutions。未來，與 R&D and Quality Solutions 相關的收入在訂閱收入與總收入中所佔比例預期將增加。我們也將部分 R&D and Quality Solutions 提供給非生命科學產業，主要在北美與歐洲地區。

截至 2026 年 1 月 31 日、2025 年 1 月 31 日與 2024 年 1 月 31 日，我們分別服務了 1,552、1,477 與 1,432 名客戶。截至 2026 年 1 月 31 日、2025 年 1 月 31 日與 2024 年 1 月 31 日，我們分別有 767、730 與 693 名 Commercial Solutions 客戶，以及 1,196、1,125 與 1,078 名 R&D and Quality Solutions 客戶。這些客戶數總計已扣除各期間的客戶流失。Commercial Solutions 與 R&D and Quality Solutions 的合併客戶數超過各年總客戶數，因為有些客戶同時訂購兩類產品。我們許多用於 R&D 的應用程式，是由規模較小、處於早期階段、尚未商業化的公司使用，其中一些公司可能無法達到商業化階段。
我們的收入主要來自訂閱費用與專業服務費用。訂閱收入包含客戶使用我們軟體與資料解決方案的費用。專業服務及其他收入主要來自與我們解決方案相關的實作服務、設定與管理服務，以及與我們講者協會物流與 Veeva 商業諮詢服務相關的服務。
在財務年度截至 2026 年 1 月 31 日，訂閱收入佔總收入的 84%，專業服務及其他收入佔總收入的 16%。

我們通常與客戶簽訂主訂閱合約，並將每一份尚未終止或到期且在當季已確認收入的獨特主訂閱合約視為一個獨特客戶，以計算我們在該季度結束時的總現有客戶數量。我們通常與每位客戶簽訂一份主訂閱合約，不過在某些情況下，同一家企業集團內的相關法律實體可能會簽訂獨立的主訂閱合約。相反地，維持獨立主訂閱合約的相關法律實體可能會選擇將其訂單合併至單一主訂閱合約下，並在此情況下，我們的客戶數量將減少。客戶的分公司、子公司及營運單位經常在相同主訂閱合約下訂購我們的訂閱服務，我們在計算總客戶數量時不會將這些獨特訂單視為新客戶。對於 Veeva Crossix，我們不會將為生命科學公司內品牌代理我們服務的機構視為獨特客戶。
我們 CRM 應用程序的新訂閱訂單通常為一年期。如果客戶在現有 CRM 應用程序訂單中增加終端使用者或額外的商業解決方案，這些額外訂單通常會與 CRM 訂單的週年日同時終止，因此，增加終端使用者或額外商業解決方案的訂單通常會有少於一年的初始合約期間。
訂閱收入通常會根據非取消性訂閱期間平均確認，這是因為客戶持續取得控制權。我們管理多年度訂單的主訂閱合約通常包含客戶的便利終止權。從這些訂單中確認的收入通常與該訂單相關期間的開票金額一致。

我們的訂閱訂單通常在訂閱期間開始時以年度或季度為單位開票，這意味著這些訂單的年度價值可能在任何單一時點不會完全反映在遞延收入中。此外，特別是針對我們商業解決方案的擴展訂單，因為增加終端使用者或應用程序的訂單期間通常少於一年以配合現有商業解決方案訂單的續約日期，這些訂單的年度價值可能在任何單一時點不會完全反映在遞延收入中。我們有時會同意，並可能在未來同意，讓客戶調整其訂單的續約日期，例如以更符合客戶的年度預算流程，或配合同一家企業控制集團內其他實體所訂訂單的續約日期，或調整付款週期從年度變為季度，或反之。這些調整可能導致訂單期間少於一年，以配合所有訂單至所期望的續約日期，因此可能導致遞延收入的增加較少。此外，續約日期的變更可能改變與特定訂單相關的遞延收入在會計年度中哪個季度入賬。因此，我們認為，以季度或年度為基礎的遞延收入變動、計算開票金額或標準化開票金額的變動，並不是未來收入的精確指標。我們定義任何期間的計算開票金額為該期間的收入加上與前一期間相比遞延收入的變動，減去與前一期間相比未開票應收帳款的變動。我們定義任何期間的標準化開票金額為計算開票金額，調整因客戶續約變更（例如將多個產品的續約日期調整為同時）或開票頻率變更（例如從年度開票變為季度開票）所產生的影響，以及因延遲續約且已結案並開票的影響。
我們的協議通常規定訂單會自動續約，除非提前通知不續約。訂閱收入主要受客戶數量、每位客戶訂購的訂閱範圍（例如終端使用者數量或其他訂閱使用指標）以及每位客戶訂購的解決方案數量影響。

我們使用自己的人員執行與客戶的專業服務及商業諮詢業務。在某些情況下，我們可能會使用第三方 subcontractor 來執行專業服務業務。我們的專業服務安排中，大多數是以時間與材料為基礎計費，收入會根據實際耗用時間及合同約定的費用率逐步確認。某些專業服務及商業諮詢安排是以固定費用為基礎計費，收入通常會根據服務實際交付情況逐步確認，基於實際耗用時間。專業服務收入主要受客戶對實施服務、配置、管理服務及講者辦公室物流的需求影響。我們的商業諮詢收入主要受客戶對我們服務的需求影響

headings: 與我們業務相關的風險
我們在營運的市場面臨激烈的競爭，若我們無法有效競爭，可能會失去客戶，並對我們的業務與營運結果產生負面影響。
我們解決方案中的瑕疵或中斷，可能會導致我們解決方案的需求下降，營收減少，並使我們面臨重大賠償責任。
若我們的新解決方案未能被新舊客戶成功採用，將會對我們營收與營運結果的成長率產生負面影響。
對美國以外國家或具有國際業務的客戶進行銷售，使我們面臨國際銷售內在的風險。
我們CRM客戶轉移至我們基於自有Veeva Vault平台所建構的Vault CRM應用程式，可能會對客戶造成業務中斷，並對我們營運結果產生負面影響。
吸引並留住高素質員工的困難，可能會對我們的業務產生負面影響，且我們為吸引及留住這些員工所付出的努力，可能會增加我們的費用。
重大事件可能幹擾我們的業務，並對我們的營運成果產生不利影響。
收購可能分散我們管理階層的注意力，導致對股東的額外稀釋，並可能幹擾我們的營運。
我們的高階管理團隊或其它關鍵人員變動，可能對我們執行業務策略的能力產生負面影響。
若我們的客戶對我們或我們合作夥伴所提供的專業或技術支援服務不滿意，可能對我們的業務產生不利影響。
與我們主要服務產業相關的風險
日益複雜的隱私權、資料保護及網路安全相關規範，可能造成負擔，可能降低我們解決方案的需求，且不遵守規範可能導致重大法律責任。
paragraphs: 投資本公司的普通股涉及高度風險。您應仔細考慮下列所描述的風險與不確定性，以及「管理層對財務狀況與營運成果之討論與分析」，並配合本報告中所有其他資訊，包括我們的合併財務報表及相關附註，再決定是否投資本公司的普通股。下列所描述的風險與不確定性並非我們唯一面臨的風險。若任何上述風險實際發生，將可能對我們的業務、財務狀況、營運成果與前景造成重大且不利的影響。在此情況下，本公司普通股的價格可能下跌，您可能損失全部或部分投資。
下列為對本公司業務的主要風險，以及持有本公司股票的相關風險摘要。此為摘要內容。您應閱讀下列及本報告其他地方更詳細的風險討論，以獲得更完整的風險說明。
•若我們的安全措施遭入侵或未經授權取得客戶資料，我們的解決方案可能被視為不安全，客戶可能減少或停止使用我們的解決方案，我們可能面臨重大賠償責任。
•我們在所從事的市場面臨激烈競爭—特別是在CRM市場，因為我們正在將客戶從我們的舊版CRM應用程式轉移至Vault CRM應用程式—若我們無法有效競爭，可能失去客戶，並對我們的業務與營運成果造成不利影響。
•我們解決方案中的缺陷或中斷可能導致我們解決方案的需求減少，進而降低我們的收入，並使我們面臨重大賠償責任。
•若我們的新解決方案未能被新舊客戶成功採用，將對我們收入與營運成果的成長率造成不利影響。
